text_block_list.text:
During training, Taiki Shuttle seemed
even less focused than usual.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That cloud looks just like a steak,
doesn't it. *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "...Sorry, Trainer. I've had so many races lately, my power is running a bit low..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... In this kind of condition,
I cannot make everyone happy-desu..."

With so many consecutive races recently, she must be feeling the fatigue.
It seems necessary to reconsider our race schedule...
